content: {"reasoning": "The claim is denied CO-197 for missing prior authorization at time of service. This payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so those paths are unavailable. Resubmitting (clean or with records) would only draw another auth denial and waste a touch. The only legitimate mechanism to progress a covered, medically-valid service denied for auth is a formal appeal with a medical-necessity argument, which is supported by a denial on the table and adequate documentation.", "action": "appeal_with_necessity"}
